summary: Iteration 81 - Invite Workspace Display & Workspace Deletion Testing Complete. All 5 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified Danger Zone section, delete confirmation input, and workspace info badge on invite accept page.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/invite/{token} correctly returns workspace_name and workspace_role when invite has workspace_id assigned
POST /api/invite/{token}/accept correctly creates user AND adds them to workspace_members with the specified role
DELETE /api/v2/workspaces/{ws_id} has proper cascade protection - refuses deletion if org_count > 0 with clear error message
Danger Zone UI (data-testid='danger-zone') correctly displays with confirmation input and delete button
Delete button correctly enables only when exact workspace name is typed
Invite accept page shows workspace info badge (data-testid='invite-workspace-info') with workspace name and role
seed_data_creation: Test invites and test workspaces created during testing were cleaned up
